item.tib: 'di yi mtshan byang zhang yig bris 'dug
item.coloph: dbang bsdud thog dmigs 'di gnyis kyi brgyud pa 'di rgyud kun tu bzang po'i (pos) ye shes mkha' 'gro ma la brgyud/ des mar ston rgyal legs/ rnal 'byor rtogs seng*/ se+e dor tshul rgyan/ blo gros rgyal mtshan/ mar ston 'od rgyan/ rig 'dzin lha yi blo gros nas/ rtsa ba'i bla ma la brgyud do//

item.tib: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i sbyin sreg
item.coloph: mkha' 'gro gsang gcod yid bzhin nor bu'i sbyin sreg bsdus ma 'di nyid/ glang zhig rgyal ba blo gros bdag gis legs par bsgrigs so/ 'gal 'khrul nor ba ci mchis rnams/ ma sring mkha' 'gro bon skyong tshogs la bzod par gsol//
